lede: KC Workshop is a car workshop at 13 Kaki Bukit Road 4, #01-26 Bartley Biz Centre, in Kaki Bukit. It was registered in September 2016.
faqs: Its listing in the Singapore Motor Workshop Association directory names accident claims, ECU programming, and engine diagnostics and troubleshooting.
Sources differ, so please see Google Maps for current hours.
sources: the Singapore Motor Workshop Association directory
